exposure.note: Ready = >= 3 canary folds that freed a slot (success, crafts > 0, freed >= 1) AND >= 1 control bot at >= 34 est. slots holding >= 2 bamboo. MEASURED 10-07: the instrument finds 22 of 65 control bots (12:00-17:40Z dry run); bag census 17:00Z: bamboo 104 slots, 5,328 pieces in 45 bags; drawexposure (craft_room refusals listing bamboo >= 5 / 3 h): 5 of 11 pools eligible (board-a, board-c, board-d, hive-a, hive-b). A 10-bot draw from those pools holds ~3-5 eligible full holders; each fold frees >= 1 slot when a batch can (19 of 29 holders could on 10-04), so >= 3 folds by +360 is expected but not measured on the fleet (bamboo never ran); the extensions carry a slow start.

own_lines.note: G1: a fold run that ended with fewer planks than it started (the bamboo-only recipe never burns planks). A death inside the run is excused and reported.
G2: sticks gained < crafts claimed (the tally over-claims the server). A death inside the run is excused and reported.

G3: bamboo gone > 2 x (crafts - the bot's own in-flight credit + the READ's in-flight credit) -- bamboo left the bag without becoming sticks (tossed, or stranded in the 2x2 grid/cursor). The read credits ONE craft in flight at a stop only on server or clean evidence; doubt/pending is EXCUSED (reported) only for a row the credit alone would pass. A death inside the run is excused and reported. bamboo-02 REVERTED on the uncorrected G3 (10-19), a read bug: no bamboo was lost.
G5: a fold past the 64-stick cap (s0 + planned > 64) that ended with more occupied slots.
G6: an unconfirmed stick _craft_sync inside a fold run whose resyncs the server did NOT answer (a denial with both resyncs answered is a known outcome, retried, not counted).
G7: a SUCCESS fold that ended with more occupied slots. Excused (reported) when a pickup row of the same bot falls inside the run, or a death.
POSITIVE CONTROL: the population (control bots at >= 34 slots holding >= 2 bamboo) is visible to this query. BLOCKS KEEP.

primary.note: REPORTED, NOT GATED: estimated occupancy DiD on a cohort of full bamboo holders fixed in the pre-window, slots freed per canary bot-hour, skips per bot-hour, stops by reason, duration p95, excused breaches by cause.

harm.note: Unchanged: the two-death floor (OWNER 2026-09-11) and gather_ratio < 0.43 of control, from immobiledid. Watch _reflex_stuck during folds (the declared window exempts only the fold).

teardown.note: THREE STEPS: drop-ins, clear canary_pool, restart the pool's bots 12 s apart; then confirm the live versions.
